test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option with correct usage of the preposition to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

__The core part in Artificial Intelligence__ (AI) is knowledge engineering, machine learning, machine perception, and robotics.

options.text: The core part on Artificial Intelligence
The core part of Artificial Intelligence
The core part from Artificial Intelligence
The core part with Artificial Intelligence

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"part"** means a piece or segment of something that together with other pieces or segments constitutes the whole. (भाग)

 
 
• **Example: **This chapter is a crucial **part **of the book.
 
 
 
• **"of"** indicates a relationship between a part and a whole. It is used to show belonging or connection. (का/के)
 
 
• **Example: **The core part** of** the machine is its engine.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'The core part of Artificial Intelligence'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: The core part on Artificial Intelligence **(Artificial Intelligence पर मुख्य भाग): "on" is not used to show the relationship of parts and wholes.

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: The core part on the machine is its engine.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: The core part from Artificial Intelligence **(Artificial Intelligence से मुख्य भाग): "from" indicates the origin or source, which does not fit here.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: The core part from the machine is its engine.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: The core part with Artificial Intelligence **(Artificial Intelligence के साथ मुख्य भाग): "with" indicates accompaniment, which is not the intended meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect usage: The core part with the machine is its engine.
 
 

2e6:Tbe1,

The correct answer is: **Option 3.**</p&g
